sentences.l2: 互联网上有很多虚拟世界。
sentences.l1: There are many virtual worlds on the internet.

sentences.l2: 很多人喜欢在虚拟世界里玩游戏。
sentences.l1: Many people like to play games in virtual worlds.

sentences.l2: 游戏里有团队合作。
sentences.l1: In games there is teamwork.

sentences.l2: 玩家可以一起做事。
sentences.l1: Players can do things together.

sentences.l2: 大家一起努力，完成任务。
sentences.l1: Everyone works hard together and completes tasks.

sentences.l2: 这就是协作。
sentences.l1: This is collaboration.

sentences.l2: 有时，玩家要比赛。
sentences.l1: Sometimes, players have to compete.

sentences.l2: 比赛有输有赢。
sentences.l1: Competitions have losers and winners.

sentences.l2: 这就是竞争。
sentences.l1: This is competition.

sentences.l2: 玩家可以和朋友一起玩。
sentences.l1: Players can play together with friends.

sentences.l2: 他们说话，计划行动。
sentences.l1: They talk and plan their moves.

sentences.l2: 他们帮助对方。
sentences.l1: They help each other.

sentences.l2: 在虚拟世界里，人们用电脑或手机连在一起。
sentences.l1: In virtual worlds, people connect with each other using computers or phones.

sentences.l2: 他们不在同一个地方，但可以一起玩。
sentences.l1: They are not in the same place, but they can play together.

sentences.l2: 有些人觉得这样很开心。
sentences.l1: Some people find this very enjoyable.

sentences.l2: 他们可以认识新朋友。
sentences.l1: They can meet new friends.

sentences.l2: 玩游戏时，团队合作很重要。
sentences.l1: When playing games, teamwork is very important.

sentences.l2: 没有团队，很难赢。
sentences.l1: Without a team, it is hard to win.

sentences.l2: 协作和竞争让游戏更有趣。
sentences.l1: Collaboration and competition make games more interesting.

sentences.l2: 玩的时候要礼貌，要尊重别人。
sentences.l1: When playing, you should be polite and respect others.
